notes.title: Announcement of the release of the improved version Prop Hunt 2.0
notes.notes:
This game has full bug fixes from the previous version, gameplay rewritten from scratch, spawn behavior logic has been changed, etc.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1870490/Prop_Hunt_20

notes.title: Important update!
notes.notes:
As requested by the community:
- Props can tease hunters (by default, the "Q" key)
- Additional settings for the host 
- Redesigned the "Snack" map
- Reworked the logic of dealing damage for hunters (now it will be easier for hunters to deal damage)

Fixed: 
- Reworked Crouch for props
- Hunter's first face no longer goes through textures

Added:
- Added a warning window for errors during game / connection on the server
- New map "Dump"

notes.title: Important Update! Information about the next update
notes.notes:
Fixed:
- Fixed a bug causing a problem when playing as a prop
- Fixed double damage from client side

Next Update Announcement:
- A new map "Dump" will be added soon
- Crouch will be redesigned from scratch

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Added:
Check of the game version, if your game version differs from the server game version, you will receive a corresponding notification.
